description: Change one of the reader's tasks (by id from list_my_tasks): mark it done, move it on to its routine's next step, move it to today / waiting / later / inbox, tick a checklist item, change its details, or delete it.

chaseOn.description: With move to waiting: YYYY-MM-DD to chase it.

item.description: With tick_item: the checklist item's id.

outcome.description: With done: how it ended (default done).

reason.description: With move to later: why it's set aside.

step.description: With set_step: the routine step's number, from 0.

until.description: With move to later: 1h, 3h, evening, tomorrow, weekend, week, month, or YYYY-MM-DD / YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM.

name: update_task
title: Update a task
